terms.authoritative_source: Versioned source designated as the governing source for a defined data domain.
terms.data_product: A governed dataset with an explicit contract, owner/steward, provenance and quality expectations.
terms.provenance: Evidence describing source, acquisition, transformation and software lineage.
terms.lineage: Ordered relationship between an input and each derived artifact or transformation.
terms.evidence_artifact: Immutable hash-addressed artifact retained to support reproducibility and review.
terms.sovereign_mode: Runtime mode restricted to signed/hash-addressed local data and no networked data sources.
terms.connected_mode: Explicitly governed runtime mode permitted to consume networked/live sources.
terms.horizontal_crs: Declared horizontal coordinate reference system for spatial records.
terms.vertical_datum: Declared vertical reference for elevation or hydraulic values; not inferred from horizontal CRS.
terms.engineering_reference_token: Privacy-reduced identifier used to relate engineering geometry without storing direct cadastral identity.
